title: Run a Check line that says prints nothing as passing when rg exits 1 with empty output, instead of leaving it to the orchestrator

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261117-233556-f24d, project ork, item S388:

Run a Check line that says prints nothing as passing when rg exits 1 with empty output, instead of leaving it to the orchestrator

Evidence: round 2 counted the no-match rg (exit 1, empty output) as a failed check, which started a fix round that changed no code
